description:
This file contains the implementation of the Image class within the Opencart
ameSpace, responsible for image resizing and caching functionalities as part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A class that manages image resizing, caching, and path management within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to specified dimensions, with caching to prevent redundant processing. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP formats.
